Commentary.Commentary: Australia's bowling for some reason was flat. They failed to bowl with the same intensity as they did on the first morning. Nathan Lyon, as mentioned before, was the best bowler on show while Mitchell Starc also bagged a 3-fer in spite of being very ordinary. A tall task is now in front of the home team, let's see how they respond with the bat. Just for the record, they have not chased a 200-plus target in Adelaide in the last 100 years. Stay tuned for the last innings...

A much-better batting performance by the touring team in their second essay. Their openers set the tone and then the middle order capitalized. Pujara's partnerships with Kohli and Rahane put India in a commanding position. Now, they have a firm control on this game and with the pitch assisting spin and bounce, all the hopes will be pinned on the responsible shoulders of Ravichandran Ashwin.

Wow! That was quick. Last four wickets for four runs. The Australian team didn't waste much time in picking the remaining wickets post Lunch. Rishabh Pant adopted an aggressive approach and hammered 18 runs in the first over of the afternoon session but then Nathan Lyon roared back to claim a 6-wicket haul. The Indian tail failed to wag this time around and Australia have been set a target of 323 runs to win this Test match.

OUT! Ishant is bounced out! Starc bangs in a lethal short delivery on middle, Sharma stands back and tries to fend at it. He takes his eyes off the ball too and ends up lobbing it in the air off the splice of his bat. A simple catch for Finch at short leg. India are all out for 307!
On a length and targeting the off pole, Sharma is doing well in keeping these out safely.
Shortish on middle, Ishant defends it from the back foot.
Terrific delivery, spears in a very full ball on off, Sharma does well to dig it out to point.
Ishant pulls out. Gets distracted by a fly in front of his face.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Ishant shuffles across to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Extra flight this time, full and spinning in, Bumrah defends it watchfully off his front foot.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Just short of silly point! Floated off spinner outside off, Bumrah stretches forward in defense but it takes his gloves and falls in front of Finch.
Goes on the back foot and plays it with the spin to leg gully.
Tossed up ball on off, Bumrah prods forward and defends.
Ishant tries to defend but the ball misses the bat outside off and goes to the keeper.
Lucky escape! Starc bowls it on a yorker length on off, the ball finds the outside edge of Ishant's bat but bounces there itself before going to the keeper.

Four byes! Poor from Starc. These are free bonus runs for India. Starc bowls three good deliveries and follows that with a poor one on leg which is again too far away for Paine to stop. Crucial runs these.
Outside off on length and Sharma lets that one go.
Outside off on length and Sharma somehow manages to keep it out.
Just short! Fuller length on off angles in and moves away. Finds an outside edge of Ishant's bat but unfortunately doesn't carry to the first slip fielder and is wide of diving Tim Paine.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot. A double-wicket maiden for Lyon.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then defends it by going inside the crease.
Lunges to a full ball and jams it down easily.
No hat-trick. Loopy ball on off, Bumrah defends it by prodding forward.
Jasprit Bumrah is the last batsman to face the hat-trick ball. The crowd is behind Lyon.

OUT! Two in two for Lyon, he's on a hat-trick now. A tossed up delivery, landing around off and turns back in. Shami shimmies down the track and tries to heave it in the stand at mid-wicket. But on the point of contact, the ball turns in and takes the inner half of the bat. It goes aerially to deep mid-wicket where Harris takes another skier easily.
Mohammed Shami is the new batsman.

OUT! Soft dismissal for Rahane! Lyon is all smiles, this is his 13th fifer in Tests. Flighted delivery, landing full around off, Rahane goes down on on knee and tries to reverse sweep against the spin. He fails to control his shot and hits it in the air. Mitchell Starc moves across to his left from point and takes the catch safely. India lead by 318 and have two wickets left.
Back of a length ball on off, Sharma blocks it off his back foot.
Digs in a short delivery outside off, Ishant makes a leave.
In the region outside off again, Ishant shuffles, tries to push at it but again misses.
Beaten, on a length and outside off, Ishant pushes at it and misses.
Ishant Sharma walks in next.

OUT! Ashwin holes out! Finally they pick a wicket off the short ball. Ashwin tries to pull it away for a maximum but doesn't connect well and finds Marcus Harris in the deep backward square leg region. Starc hasn't looked good but gets his second wicket.
Length ball down the leg, side, Ashwin leaves. Paine stretches to his left to collect the ball.
Nicely played again. No risk at all. Full and flighted outside off, Rahane strides forward with an angled bat and pushes it through backward point for an easy couple.
Short in length and outside off, Rahane cuts it past the diving point fielder for a couple of runs. 300 up for India, lead by 315.
Tossed up ball on off, Ajinkya runs down the track and blocks it back.
Once again Rahane uses his feet and defends it down wide of short leg.
Steps down the track to a full ball around off and defends it to the off side.
Floated off spinner on middle and leg, Rahane kneels and paddles it fine down the leg side for a brace.
Starc drags it on the leg side, Ashwin leaves it.
Outside off on length, Ashwin chases it and misses.
Defended off the front foot by Ashwin.
Length on middle, angling down leg, Rahane flicks it behind square for a single.
Swing and a miss. Length delivery outside off, a bit of movement away from the batsman. Rahane swings his bat at it and he's lucky that the ball goes past the outside edge.
Length ball on off and Rahane hits it to the fielder at cover.
Short deliver on off, Rahane moves back and pulls it with the spin to deep square leg for a run. Done with 100 overs, India lead by 311.
Allows the ball to turn back in and then gently taps it to covers for one.
Loopy and around off, Ashwin decides to defend it from the back foot.
A firm sweep shot by Rahane, goes at a brisk pace to deep mid-wicket. A single.
Walks forward to the pitch of the delivery and defends it back.

Stumping chance? Tough. Floated off spinner on middle, Ashwin rushes down the track for a big shot but misses the ball completely. It spins back big, beats the leg stump and further turns away. Paine fails to collect as a result and they take three byes.
Ashwin pushes it to the fielder in the point region.
Running down the leg, Ashwin flicks it on the leg side for one.

FOUR BYES! Short and the ball bounces high off the pitch. Ashwin leaves it but the ball bounces so high that Paine couldn't hold onto the ball and it races away to the boundary. Bad from Starc. These are free runs. He must direct the bouncer better especially to the new batsman.
Fuller and Ashwin blocks it off.
Outside off, tempting Ashwin to go for it but Ashwin refuses to do so and leaves it behind to the keeper.
Length outside off, the ball angles in a bit after pitching Ashwin pushes it off his back foot.

In the air... SAFE! Would have been an unfortunate dismissal for Ash. Flighted off spinner landing around off and spinning back in. Ashwin stays back to hit across the line and it hits short leg before ballooning in the air. Paine runs across to his left, Harris sprints forward from backward square leg - both dive but the ball falls right in between. They cross for a run and the lead is now 300 runs.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Ashwin waits on the back foot and steers it at the last moment towards third man. A couple of runs to get off the mark.
Turning down the leg side, Ashwin clips it off his pads to backward square leg.
Spin and bounce from outside off, Ashwin moves back and taps it down to short leg.
Flighted off spinner on off, Ashwin defends it from the crease.
Ravichandran Ashwin is the new batsman.

OUT! Live by the sword, die by the sword. Pant is out of here. Lyon tosses it up generously outside off and gets it to spin away. Pant tries to dismiss it over covers with an inside-out shot but ends up handing a simple catch to Finch at sweeper cover. The cameo is over. Lyon has the last laugh. He gets his revenge in the form of his fourth wicket. India's lead is three short of 300.
Outside off stump and Rahane has no second thought of leaving that one.
Fuller this time and Ajinkya blocks it off his front foot.
FOUR! Beautiful! Overpitched outside off by Starc, Rahane looks in amazing touch today as he exquisitely drives it through covers for a boundary.
Outside off on length, Rahane doesn't disturb that one.
Woah! The ball is pitched outside off on a length, it jags back in and hits on the back leg of Rahane, who went for a front foot defense there.
Round the wicket, outside off on length, Rahane lets it go.
Mitchell Starc to bowl.

SIX! Launches a rocket! 18 from the over, what a start to the session. India's lead is now 7 short of 300. Flighted delivery, landing full on middle, Pant kneels down and slogs it emphatically over mid-wicket for a biggie. It's going to be an entertaining session, folks.

FOUR! Pant is going bang, bang, bang... Advances down the track to a full ball and powers it over mid on. Once again the connection ain't proper but it still has enough to take the ball past the fence.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Rishabh. However, this time he didn't get the connection right. Jumps out of the crease and swings his bat across the line. It takes the inside half of the bat but still speeds away through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Two balls spent defending and that's all. How refreshing is this player! Wears his skates to a full ball around leg and heaves it against the spin over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower through the air as it lands on off and breaks away. Pant stays back and defends it down safely.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle, Pant gets forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Welcome back for the afternoon session. The men concerned are back on the field. Rishabh Pant will be on strike. Nathan Lyon to begin proceedings...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

Top session for India. They have further strengthened their position in this Test match. The pair of Cheteshwar Pujara and Ajinkya Rahane dominated most parts of the morning half as they put together an 87-run stand. The Australian bowling was flat, to say the least, however, Nathan Lyon bowled his heart out and eventually snapped a couple of wickets. The Indian lead is now 25 short of 300 and they will be eager to bat at least one more session to maximize it. In Rahane and Pant, the tourists have a perfect match in the middle and we can expect some fireworks post Lunch. Do join us in a short while for all the action.
Outside off and Rahane shoulders arms to it. That's Lunch on Day 4.
Bouncer again and Rahane ducks underneath it.
On length and Rahane defends it from the crease.
Bouncer and Rahane lets it go to the keeper.
Full and Rahane blocks it off his front foot.
Length delivery on middle, the ball moves with the angle and Pant pushes it off his back foot towards point for a single.
Flighted off spinner on middle, from 'round the wicket, Rahane defends it by covering the spin.
Flatter and shorter on off, turning away a bit, Pant stays back and forces it down to long on for a run.
Quicker this time, turning back in from outside off, Rahane quietly helps it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and then defends it back.
Short this time, wide outside off, Pant goes back and cuts it through the line. Finds gap at point and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Connects and connects well this time! Loopy full ball landing around off, Pant takes a big stride forward and muscles it over mid on for a boundary.
Fuller length delivery and Rahane keeps it out.
On good length but  down the leg, Pant flicks it on the leg side for a single.
Full and on off, Ajinkya pushes it to the point region for a single.
Full and outside off, Ajinkya blocks it away.
Full and on off, Rahane beautifully defends off his front foot.
Full and on off, Rahane defends by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Pat Cummins is into the attack now.
Turns and bounce from around off, Pant pulls his bat away at the very last moment. End of a successful over for Lyon.
Pant has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Beaten! Good response from the bowler. Drifts it in from around off, Pant tries to defend but it spins away to beat the bat.

And straightaway Pant decides to take on Lyon. Flighted ball on middle, Rishabh swings his bat hard and hits it in the air. Not much timing behind it though. It falls in the deep at long on and stops. They take a couple.
Rishabh Pant's turn.

OUT! Terrific catch by Peter Handscomb at silly point! Lyon strikes again and is all smiles. All the hard work is paying off now for the Aussie off spinner. Flighted delivery around off, turning back in slightly this time with extra bounce. Sharma is drawn forward in defense but fails to get his bat on it. It then pops out towards silly point where Peter reacts quickly and dives across to his right to take a one-handed catch inches above the surface. A bit similar to Pujara's wicket. The ball brushing the pads first and then taking the gloves. India lead by 263 runs.
Beaten! Full and flighted outside off, Rohit is forward to play for the turn but it skids through to beat the outside edge.
Overpitched by Josh and Ajinkya drives it through the cover region for a couple. The ball doesn't have the legs to go to the boundary.
Astutely defended by Rahane off his front foot.
Full and on off, Rahane blocks it away.

FOUR! Fifty for the vice captain, his 16th in Test cricket. A much-needed one for him. He wasn't in the best of form before the start of this innings but it looks like that has changed. This is a delightful news for India and one that will dread Australia. Coming back to the ball, it was short and Rahane picks the bones out of it. The ball races away towards the square leg region for a boundary.
Short of a length, Sharma goes on to his back foot and pushes the ball on leg side for a single. Gets off the mark.
Full outside off, a bit of movement there but Rohit keeps it out.
FOUR! Takes a good calculative risk and sends it across the fence. Loopy and around off, Rahane skips down the track and flicks it with the turn over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another delivery worked away with the spin but straight to backward square leg.
Spin and bounce from middle, Rahane goes back and taps it down to square leg.
Lets the ball spin back in and defends it by closing the face of the bat.
Edgy! Rahane comes down the track again and tries to defend. It takes the inside edge and flies wide of short leg.
Full and on middle, Rahane walks forward and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Length on off, Rohit keeps it out.
Close. Length delivery outside off, the ball shapes away and misses the outside edge of Rohit's bat by a whisker.
Short once again and Rahane confidently pulls it towards the square leg region for a single.
Length delivery on off, Ajinkya blocks it out.
Short and Rahane comfortably pulls it behind square for two runs. India's lead crosses 250.
Length on middle, Rahane keeps it out off his front foot.
Rohit Sharma arrives with India leading by 249 runs. The stage is set for him.

OUT! First success for Australia this morning! Lyon gets a breakthrough finally. He has been the most impressive bowler for the Aussies and is rewarded for his perseverance. A tossed up delivery landing outside off, Pujara strides forward to wear it on his pads but it bounces extra, raps him on the front thigh pad and then takes some part of his gloves before lobbing to Finch at short leg. They appeal and the finger goes up. The 87-run stand is broken, devil's number benefiting Australia for a change. Pujara walks back with his head high. Tremendous effort by India's number three, 194 runs in total from his blade in this Test. For the stats, this is the 8th time Lyon has dismissed Pujara in Test cricket, the most Che has got out to a bowler.
Turn and bounce on middle, Pujara tries defending but it takes his pads and lobs over short leg.
Flighted and outside off, Che pads it away.
Pujara has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Advances down the track to a full ball and tries to defend. Fails to put bat on ball and is hit on the pads.
Goes on the back foot and works it off his pads to square leg.
Length delivery on off, Rahane defends it off his back foot.
Full, Ajinkya pushes it straight back at the bowler, who gathers it on his follow-up.
Full on middle, Rahane firmly blocks it off his front foot.
Good length on off, Jinx defends it off his back foot.
Short outside off, Rahane plays the pull but straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length outside off, Rahane isn't tempted to disturb that.
Floated on middle, Pujara walks down the track and pads it away.
Spinning in sharply and taking Pujara's thigh pad before dropping in front of short leg.
Tickles it away with the spin, slightly uppish but in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Turning down the leg side, Pujara taps it down to square leg for a run. He seems to have pulled his hamstring. Pickle juice?
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Full length ball around off, Rahane skips down the track and drives it through mid off. The ball slows down before the rope and they take three.
Leg bye! On middle and leg, Rahane tries to flick it but misses and the ball hits his pad and goes towards the fine leg region for a single.
Full on off, Rahane confidently blocks it away.
Length delivery outside off, Jinx leaves it away.
Fuller again and Rahane pushes it towards the mid on fielder.
Full on off, Rahane blocks it off his front foot.
Rahane leaves the ball pitched outside off.
Josh Hazlewood bowling from the other end.
Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning back in, helped down to square leg.

Needless excitement shown by the close-in fielders. Loopy full ball around off, Che advances down the track and tries to defend but misses. It hits him on the pads and then drops on the surface. Appeal for a bat-pad and then lbw by the Aussies, nothing doing as far as the umpire is concerned.
Tossed up ball on middle, worked away to mid-wicket.

Catch it is the shout... SAFE! A flighted ball on middle, Rahane steps down the track and flicks it aerially over square leg. Harris in the deep runs forward but the ball drops in front of him. They pick up a single.
Turn and bounce from around middle, Rahane helps it off his pads to backward square leg.
Nathan Lyon is back on to operate with the new ball.
FOUR! WOW! Che going uppish. Short by Starc outside off, Pujara brings out the upper cut from his armour and flies it towards the third man region for a boundary.
Pujara tries to defend it but the ball misses the bat.
Length delivery, the ball rises after pitching and hits the glove of Pujara.

FOUR BYES! Once again Starc misses his line and length. Bowls it wide on leg and the ball moves away. Pujara leaves it alone. Paine dives to his left, gets his hand to it but cannot stop the ball from going to the boundary. Mitch is clearly struggling with his landing, not looking in any sort of rhythm.
Length delivery outside off, Pujara shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, Pujara tries to defend off his back foot but the ball straightens after pitching and misses the outside edge. Better from Starc.
A hint of away shape, Rahane lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Rahane brings down a straight bat and pushes it to mid on.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lovely away movement off the seam outside off, Rahane shoulders arms.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
In the channel outside off, Rahane allows it through.
Change in bowling. Josh Hazlewood is brought back into the attack.

Four byes! Starc bowling over the wicket to the right-hander. Bowls down the leg, The ball is swinging away, Pujara leaves it and diving Tim Paine cannot even get a hand to it. The ball races away to the fence.
Length delivery on off, the ball goes with the angle and Rahane gets on his back foot and pushes it towards the point region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Rahane chooses not to play that.

FOUR! Shot of the session. Starc bowls it full on off, he gets a hint of inswing but Rahane hits it straight down the ground for a single. When Rahane is on song there are very few players as beautiful as him to watch.
Full on off and Rahane blocks it off his back foot.
Length on off, Rahane defends off his back foot. He initially wanted a single but changes his mind immediately.
Second new ball has been taken by Australia. Mitchell Starc is back on to make first use of the Kookaburra.
Full and around off, Che walks forward and pushes it to mid on.
Tossed up ball on off, defended from the crease by Che.
Advances down the track to a full ball and flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Allows the ball to spin back in and helps it in front of square leg for a run.

In the air... But was there any bat? Turn and bounce from around off, Rahane tries to paddle it away but misses to get hit on the pads. It balloons in the air but drops safely before the short backward square leg fielder can get there.
Flighted off spinner around off, Rahane defends it off his back foot.

Drinks break. Magnificent morning for India. They haven't lost any wicket on Day 4 and have managed to swell their lead to 224 runs. Pujara and Rahane are going strong at the moment while Australia's bowling has looked quite flat with the exception of Nathan Lyon. Will the script change in the next 75 minutes?
Once again a bumper and Pujara ducks underneath it. They need to change their tactics here. Pujara is not being troubled by these short ones.
Bouncer by Pat. Pujara evades it.

FOUR! Bad delivery by Cummins there. With the form Pujara is in, he will hit these deliveries for a boundary even in his sleep. It was bowled short and down the leg, Che flicks it towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Short down the leg side, Pujara leaves it away.
Short this time and Pujara blocks it off his back foot. The ball is tapped into the ground and the fielder at fine short leg had no chance.
Full on middle, Pujara flicks it on the leg side through mid-wicket for a couple. Loose delivery by Pat there.
A failed attempt to play the sweep shot by Rahane. No real appeal on this occasion as the impact was easily outside off.
Hurries down the track to a full ball and drives it back in the direction of the bowler. Lyon dives to his left to stop the ball.
Shortish and outside off, Che goes back and cuts it wide of point for one.
Works it away with the spin through square leg for a run.
Dropped? Nopes. Flighted off spinner around off, Rahane leans forward to defend but it takes the inside edge, brushes his pads and flies wide of Finch at short leg.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Length delivery again this time and Pujara pushes it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery on middle and off, Pujara flicks it on the leg side and a good diving effort by Handscomb at short square leg to save runs for his team.
Beautifully pulled this time towards the fine leg fielder for a single.
Short and Rahane tries to hit the upper cut but misses the ball. He is lucky that the ball misses the edge.
Shorter this time and the ball is flicked away towards square leg for a single. And with that flick India's total moves to 200. They are in a commanding position in this match.
Round the wicket, Length delivery outside leg, Pujara leaves it.
Rahane has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Steps down the track and helps it through mid-wicket for one.
Goes on the back foot and turns it behind square leg for one.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and defends it back.

What happened there? Umpire Nigel Llong is quite vocal. He points out that the backward square leg fielder is stepping back when the bowler is in his bowling stride which isn't allowed. A fielder can take a head-start and move forward, but not backwards. Good spot, Nigel.
A half-shout for an lbw! Tossed up ball outside off, Rahane tries sweeping but misses. He is hit on the pads but the impact is outside off.
Digs in a bouncer on middle, Pujara sits underneath it to complete the over. Quite easy at the moment for India.
Steams in from 'round the wicket and darts in a full ball on middle, it's defended back from the crease by Che.
Bumper again! Pujara ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Taps a length ball down to the off side and pinches a single. 50-run stand comes up.
FOUR! Shot! That found the sweet spot of his bat. Cummins delivers it on a length outside off, Rahane plays a punchy-drive through covers for a cracking boundary.
Wide called for bouncer! Cummins goes short around off, Rahane sways away from the line and it's too high.
Goes back inside the crease and helps it with the spin to square leg for one.
A little shimmy down the track by Pujara as he whips it uppishly but past short leg for a run.
Turns it off his pads to short leg.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and pushes it to covers for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot! Lyon pulls his length back and bowls it around off, Rahane goes deep inside the crease and pulls it with authority through mid-wicket for a boundary. Lead is now 200!

Not out! Nothing there. Lyon serves a flighted off spinner around off, Rahane dances down the track and then tries to defend with his bat close to the front pad. It pops out off his pads, the short leg fielder catches it, they appeal and the finger goes up. Rahane quickly takes the DRS and the replays detect no wood. Also, the third umpire checks for the lbw but it's too high.
Ajinkya Rahane is given out, caught at short leg. He takes the DRS.
Once again length delivery on off, Pujara defends off his back foot.
Length delivery on off, Che blocks it away.
Two on the trot by Pat. Cummins bowls a bouncer once again and Pujara has no issues ducking underneath it.
Bouncer once again and Che ducks underneath it.
Length delivery outside off, Rahane goes on his back foot and punches away for a single.
Full on middle and off, Rahane keeps it away off his front foot.
Works it with the spin to the leg side, once again to square leg.
Spinning back into the batsman, Pujara moves back to defend but gets an inside edge through his legs to square leg.
Flighted and way wide outside off, not turning back in enough, Pujara takes his front leg outside the line of the stumps and pads it away.
Catch it is the shout, nothing doing. Pujara shimmies down the track and defends it with his bat and pad together. Slight inside edge there but not carrying to any of the close-in fielders.
Spin and bounce from outside off, Pujara offers no shot and takes it on his pads.
Floated full ball around off, Rahane skips down the track and drives it through mid on for three runs.
Rahane flicks it away towards the square leg region for a single.

WIDE! Too short by Cummins. Rahane tries to move away from the line but his bat is hanging like a periscope. That wasn't far from kissing the edge of the blade. Cummins is shocked when he sees that the umpire has called it a wide ball.
Slight altercation there. Aaron Finch and Cheteshwar Pujara involved in war of words. Umpire Dharmasena intervenes.
Length deliver on middle and off, Che flicks it on the leg side for and easy single.
Wide down the leg side, Pujara shoulders arms to it.
Pitches on middle and leg, the ball angles in and Rahane flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Once again length delivery on off, Rahane defends it with a straight bat.
Length delivery on off, Rahane blocks it off his front foot.
Pat Cummins is into the attack.
Whoa! Extra spin and bounce, Pujara decides to offer no shot and takes a blow on his body. This is turning out to be a tough pitch with every passing minute.
Steps down the track and brings his bat and pad together in defense. A stifled appeal for an lbw dies down quickly.
FOUR! Easily put away! A friendly long hop by Lyon, it's around off and this time Pujara picks it early. He immediately goes inside the crease and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket.
Beaten in flight! Nicely tossed up again by Lyon. It lands just short outside off, turning back in just a hint, Pujara is neither back nor forward as he pushes inside the line to get beaten.
Lyon is on the shorter side with his length, it's around off and Rahane goes back to work it in front of square leg for a run.
Flighted on off, Rahane walks forward and pushes it to silly mid on.
Outside off on a length, Pujara leaves it alone.
A bit fuller this time and Pujara blocks it off his front foot.
Beauty. Length delivery pitching on off, jags back in sharply to beat Pujara's defense and hit him on the thigh pad.
Length delivery once again this time outside off, Pujara leaves it away.
Length delivery on off, Che blocks it off his front foot.
Full outside off, Pujara tries to drive it on the off side but the ball hits the inner half and goes towards the fielder at mid-wicket.

Tossed up ball outside off, Rahane once again uses his feet and then tries to defend. Gets an inside edge onto the pads as the ball rolls wide of the keeper. Rahane immediately gets back inside the crease. A much-better over by Lyon.
Shortish and on off, turning back in, Rahane works it around off his hips but finds backward square leg.
Shimmies down the track to a full ball around off and defends it back.
Allows the delivery to spin back in from around off and then taps it down towards short leg.
Slow and full outside off, Rahane leans forward in defense.

Nearly walks into the trap. Rahane dances down the track to play the flick shot and does so in the air. Luckily for him, it falls just short of short mid-wicket. There are three catching fielders on the leg side.
Bouncer! Quick and short by Starc, Pujara gets away from that ball.
Short and Rahane pulls it away to the square leg fielder for a single.
Mitchell Starc is not looking at his best. He is already down by at least 10 kph in his speed. Is he carrying any niggle?
A tad fuller this time and Ajinkya defends it with a straight bat.
Length delivery on off this time by Starc, Rahane blocks it off his front foot.
FOUR! Beautifully punches off the back foot through backward point for a boundary. A very loose delivery by Starc there, offers Rahane width and Ajinkya has no problem punishing it.
Length delivery outside off, Rahane leaves it. The ball rises onto the keeper.
Change of ends for Mitchell Starc.
Steps down the track to a full ball and eases it down through mid on for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Walks forward to the pitch of the delivery and blocks it back.
Flatter and shorter again on off, Rahane defends it off his back foot.

Fifty up for Pujara, his 20th in Tests! Lyon bowls it slightly short around off and it turns back in from there. Che goes deep inside the crease and cuts it behind backward point for three runs. Good hands of Pujara! Yet another valuable knock by him. Taking the lead to 180.
Full and flighted outside off, Rahane straightaway jumps out of the crease and forces it down to long on for a run.
Nathan Lyon is introduced into the attack after just two overs from Mitchell Starc. A slip, leg gully and short leg in place.
A better directed bouncer by Josh this time. Pitches it outside off and Pujara ducks underneath it. A bouncer in and around off will trouble the batsman more than the one drifting down the leg.
Length on off by Hazlewood, Pujara keeps it away off the back foot.
Bouncer! On middle and leg, the ball is going down the leg and Che ducks underneath it.
Once again on length outside off, Pujara calmly leaves it.
On length on off stump, Che blocks it off his back foot.
Short outside off, Pujara drops his wrists and lets it go.
Pitches it up and around off, Rahane draws forward and pushes it to mid off to end the over.
Good length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.

Bangs in a short delivery around middle and leg, Rahane is early into the pull shot due to the slowness of the track and lobs it up on the leg side. Luckily it falls safely away from the two close-in fielders.
This one is in the line of the stumps. On a fuller length and Rahane covers the line and defends it towards mid on.
Starc digs in a short delivery around off, Ajinkya stands tall inside the crease and cuts it well in front of point for a couple of runs.
Full and around off, Rahane is on the front foot as he defends it watchfully.

EDGY FOUR! Hazlewood serves it on a length around off and gets it to straighten a bit. Pujara plays inside the line from the crease and gets an outside edge. It speeds past the diving gully fielder for a boundary. The outfield certainly has quickened up today.

FOUR! First runs of the day and it's a boundary. Pujara gets on his front foot and drives the ball through covers for a boundary. Overpitched by Starc this time outside off. The ball makes a sweet sound as soon as it hit Pujara's blade. No one's stopping that.
Good length delivery outside off, Pujara lets it go.
Length delivery on off, Pujara defends it off his front foot.
A tad shorter this time, Pujara blocks it off his front foot.
Full on off, Che starts with his traditional front foot defense.
It's going to be Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, Rahane shoulders arms to it.
Once again outside off, Rahane isn't tempted to play that one and lets it go.
Fuller this time outside off, Rahane pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Good length outside off, Rahane leaves it alone.
Full length delivery on off, Ajinkya blocks it off his back foot.
Starc stars with a low full toss on middle and leg, it's pushed back to the bowler by Rahane.

It's time to get going. The players are making their way out in the centre. Australia are wearing black armbands in memory of Colin Guest, who passed away yesterday. Out come the Indian overnight pair of Ajinkya Rahane and Cheteshwar Pujara. The ball is with Mitchell Starc as he loosens up to bowl the first over of the day. Here we go...

Pitch report - The pitch will hold up well with a good covering of grass, feels Mark Waugh. He adds that it's going to be tough to judge the spin and bounce from the footmarks which are mainly outside the right-handers' off stump. Mark further says that there is not much rough outside left-handers' off stump, so Ashwin will have to try and mix up his line and length.

The sun shone on India on a damp Day 3 as they managed to drive home the advantage. After gaining a 15-run advantage, their batsmen applied themselves better than the first innings to put the touring team in a commanding position. Given the nature of the pitch, Australia would be feeling the heat already but their first aim this morning will be to limit the damage. An important session in the context of this Test match is minutes away from unfolding itself. Hello and welcome everyone. Stay tuned for more updates.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

The lead now has swelled to 166 and India still have a lot of batting to come. Another decent stand and handy contributions from the rest will probably see them bat Australia out of the game. The hosts, on the other hand, need a few quick wickets as that is the only way they can get back into the contest. The morning of Day 4 will probably give us a fair idea of who has a better chance to take a 1-0 lead. Do join us for the coverage, not to forget, we have a 30-minute early start. So join us at 1000 local (2330 GMT) for all the action. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Earlier in the day, after quite a few delays, we saw the game evenly poised as Australia managed to reduce the deficit to 15 runs. However, their bowlers failed to recreate the same magic as they did in the first innings. The Indian openers stepped up when it was needed and provided a good start. The tourists then lost two wickets in a quick succession but Kohli and Pujara added another handy stand to put India on the front foot.

Another session which belongs to the Indians and one can say they are in the driver's seat at the moment. This session began with Kohli and Pujara grinding it out. They, just like the openers, took their time and played themselves in. The pair stitched an excellent 71-run stand off 197 balls. However, just when they looked like taking the game away from the hosts, Lyon struck and provided some relief to Australia. The hosts would have liked another wicket or two before Stumps but Rahane and Pujara ensured there were no more hiccups.
Last ball of the day and Pujara keeps it out. Fuller length this time and Che pushes it towards the point fielder. Stumps on Day 3.
Fuller this time and Pujara blocks it off his front foot.
Length outside off, Cheteshwar shoulders arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball rises after pitching, Pujara somehow manages to keep it away from danger.
Short this time, Pujara ducks underneath it.
Length delivery outside off, Pujara lets it go.
Sharp turn there! It is pitched outside off, it turns back in sharply. Rahane fails to put bat on ball and it hits him high on the pads.
Steps down the track and Rahane blocks it out.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Uses his feet again but does not get to the pitch of it. Tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and goes towards the leg side.
Another flighted ball on middle, the batsman strokes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, it is defended.
Bumper by Hazlewood, Rahane tries to duck it but the ball rises on him and hits him on his helmet. The ball moves towards the fine leg region and the batsmen take three runs there.
On off and Ajinkya shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, Rahane isn't tempted to play that one.
Fuller on middle and off, Rahane flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Rahane leaves it alone.
Full on off, Rahane defends it off his front foot.
Flatter on middle, Pujara tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Rahane dances down the track and strokes it through covers. The fielder there makes a good diving stop. He can't stop the single though.
In the air... but safe! Once again it is tossed up outside off, Rahane tries to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and lobs just wide of short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Ajinkya Rahane is the new man in.

OUT! Lyon at last gets the breakthrough. Finally, a ball takes an inside edge and goes to hand. The celebration tells you how relieved they are. Another Indian batsman can't make most of the start. This is tossed up outside off, it turns back in sharply as Kohli stretches forward in defense. But it takes the inside edge, hits the pad and lobs to short leg. Finch there grabs an easy catch. The stand which was taking the game away from the Aussies has been broken. This is the 6th time Lyon has got Kohli out in Tests, no bowler has dismissed him more. Can Australia take a couple more and end the day on a high?
Full and outside off, Pujara tries to defend the ball but the ball misses his bat and goes straight to the keeper.
Full on off, Kohli defends off his front foot and quickly calls his partner for a single. They easily complete the single.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli leaves it alone.
Short of a length this time Kohli pushes it towards the fielder at point region.
Full once again outside off, Kohli blocks it and wants a single, Pujara refuses him straightaway.
Full outside off, Kohli blocks it off the front foot.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Another appeal, an ambitious one though. Pujara comes down the track and tries to defend but the ball hits the pads and lobs towards short leg.
Once again, Pujara lets the ball do its bit and then with the spin, it is flicked to mid-wicket.
Works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, the batter keeps it out.

Australia are now appealing for everything here! Pujara uses his feet and tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players around the batsman start appealing. Lyon, on the other hand, dives full stretch to catch the ball and then appeals for a caught and bowled. The umpire is no interested in both the appeals though. Desperate times bring desperate measures.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Starc bowling at the body of the skipper but Virat has no problems keeping it away. He pushes the ball towards the point region.
On a length on middle, VK defends by showing full face off the bat off his back foot.
Close. Back of a length by Starc, Kohli goes on his back foot and tries to flick it towards the leg side but finds a leading edge. Luckily the ball doesn't reach the bowler.
Once again length delivery on middle, Kohli defends off his back foot.
Length delivery on middle, blocked off the back foot by Virat.
Bouncer and ducked underneath by Kohli.
Tossed up delivery on off, Pujara comes down the track and pads it away.
Flatter and on off, the batter pushes it back to the bowler.
Once again plays it with the turn towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, this one gets big on the batsman. Kohli does well to adjust and work it towards backward square leg.
On off, Kohli works it with the turn to short leg.
Gives it air on off, the batsman blocks it out.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Perfect front foot defense by Che. Full length delivery outside off, Pujara gets right behind the ball and defends it.
Length delivery outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Defended off the back foot by Pujara.
A tad shorter this time, Kohli gets on his back foot and blocks it, the fielders are at a distance and Pujara calls Virat for a quick single.
Kohli has defended that off his front foot into the ground.

FOUR! Easy pickings for Virat there. Full outside off, overpitched by Starc and Kohli punches it through the covers for a boundary. There are very few players who play the cover drive as beautifully as Virat.
Floats it up on off, Pujara keeps it out.
Dances down the track and works it towards mid on. The fielder at short mid-wicket dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Outside off, it spins back in sharply. Pujara pads it away.
FOUR! Another poor ball and it has been dispatched! Short and on middle, the batsman goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket and the ball races away.
This is now worked through square leg and a run is taken.
Dances down the track and works it to long on for a single. India's lead is now 150, still 8 wickets in hand.
Length ball pitching on middle and leg, Kohli tries to flick but the ball hits his pads.
Again a bouncer which is not directed properly. VK ducks underneath it with absolute ease.
Length delivery on middle, Kohli blocks it off his back foot.
Once again short this time the ball is going away from Kohli. He easily guides it towards the third man region for a couple.
Length delivery outside leg, Kohli shoulders arms to it.
Starts off with a shorter one on leg, VK ducks underneath it.
Mitchell Starc is back on. Before that, he was seen having a chat with Tim Paine and Josh Hazlewood. Concerned looks on the Aussie players as the lead is almost 150 now.
A couple to end the over! Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
This is pitched on middle, it turns away further. Pujara tries to put bat on ball but misses.
Tries to work it through square leg but the short leg fielder comes in the way.
Flatter and outside off, Pujara guides it to point.

Now works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end. The run also brings the 50-run stand up. A much-needed one as India had lost two quick wickets when this pair joined forces. They are now strengthening India's hold on the game.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack Head, says Kohli. Short and on middle, the batsman rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Travis Head is into the attack.
Once again a half tracker from Cummins. Pujara ducks underneath it. These bouncers need to be better directed if they want Pujara to be troubled by them.
FOUR! Poor from Pat, bowls it down leg. Che easily flicks it through fine leg for a boundary. Pujara will punish those deliveries everyday of the week.
Good length delivery outside off, Pujara tries to block it off his front foot, the ball finds the outer half of the bat.
Once again a shorter delivery by Cummins to Pujara. He ducks underneath it.
Length delivery on leg stump, the ball moves away with the angle. Pujara lets it alone.
Cummins bowls it full on off, CP pushes it towards the long on region for a brace.
This is on the shorter side around off, Pujara goes back and punches it through mid off for three.
This time he finds the gap in the mid-wicket region and a single results.
With the turn, the batsman works it to square leg.
On the shorter side, the batsman goes back and flicks it to short leg.
Tosses it up outside off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Flatter on off, the batsman goes back and works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Bumper by Cummins, Pujara ducks underneath that one.
Once again the ball moves towards the legs of Che. He flicks it on the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Length delivery on middle, CP flicks to the fielder at square leg.
Pujara tries to drive it to the point region, the ball finds the inner half and goes straight back at the bowler.
Full and outside off, Pujara drives it straight to the fielder at cover.
Good bouncer! A well directed one there by Cummins, but Pujara evades it.
Drinks!
A little too full outside off, the batsman strokes it through covers for a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
A little too straight this time and it is worked to short leg.
Nicely bowled! Tossed up outside off, Kohli lunges and plays for the non-existent turn and gets beaten.
Flatter and outside off, it is guided to point for a run.
The batsman dances down the track and works it to mid-wicket.
A tad fuller this time by Pat, Kohli hits it straight to the fielder at mid on.
Once again on length outside off, Virat shoulders arms to it.
Good length delivery on off, VK defends it with a straight bat.
On a length once again, Kohli blocks it from within the crease.
A bit fuller this time, the skipper beautifully drives it square, but straight to the point fielder.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it off his front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and outside off, the batsman defends it to covers but dancing down the track.
FOUR! Poor ball and it has been put away! Short and outside off, Pujara rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Uses his feet and this time he tries to defend with his bat ahead of the pad. He misses as it hits his front pad. A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Tosses it up outside off, Pujara pads it away.
Flatter on middle, the batsman works it to mid-wicket.
On a length this time on off, the ball gets big onto the Indian skipper who blocks it off his back foot.
Once again a bouncer by Cummins, this time the ball is down the leg side, Virat ducks underneath that.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli defends it off his front foot.
Good bouncer! Short in length, the ball rises onto Kohli who blocks it off his back foot.
On a length outside off, Kohli doesn't even attempt a shot there.
Length delivery on off, Kohli flicks it to the square leg fielder.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
On the shorter side outside off, Pujara has a lot of time to go back and guide it through point for a run.
The straighter one on off, Pujara defends it out.
This is floated on off, Pujara pushes it back to the bowler.
Shortish and on off, Kohli rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli keeps it out off the outer half of his blade to gully. A single taken.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angling into the batsman on a length, Kohli defends it close to his body to mid-wicket.
A bouncer down the leg side, easily left by the batsman.
Way outside off, Pujara pads it away.
Once again he steps down the track and does not get to the ball. He kicks it away.
Dances down the track again but does not get to the pitch of it. He tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Another beauty! The straighter one outside off, Pujara plays inside the line and gets beaten. Not sure if intentionally played it inside the line or was beaten.

NOT OUT! That is going over the stumps! Once again Pujara makes excellent use of the review in this innings. Lyon can't believe it. However, Pujara could not believe it when he was given out. Coming to the ball now - this was tossed up outside off, Pujara comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. He tries to pad it away with his bat behind the pad. An appeal follows and the umpire agrees. Pujara has a baffled look on his face and he reviews immediately. The replays roll in and it shows the ball to be going over. The on-field call has to be overturned.

Big moment! Pujara has been judged LBW. He has reviewed it. Looks close this one. Remember his bat is hiding behind his front pad, so that won't be counted as a shot attempted. 3 metre rule will also come in this case. Let's see.
Flatter on off, the batsman pushes it to mid-wicket.
Well bowled and well played! This pitches and then shoots off. Kohli plays it well by taking a hand off the handle.
Back of a length on off, Kohli stands tall and blocks it out.
A bumper now, Kohli ducks under it. Taking his time here is the Indian skipper, ready to wait for the bad balls.
On the fuller side, Kohli strokes it to covers.
Goes very full, trying to hit the pads of Kohli. The Indian skipper though gets bat on ball and flicks it to mid on.
On a length outside off, left alone. Kohli looks set now.
Slower through the air on off, Pujara who is happy to play Lyon off the back foot, does so again here. Goes back and works it to square leg.
Another floated delivery on middle, Kohli strokes it down to long on for a run.
This is floated on middle, Che works it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Slower through the air on off, Pujara goes back and guides it to point.
Whips this down to long on and gets to the other end.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli lunges and blocks it out.
Another leave outside off to end the over.
On a length and outside off, it's left alone by Pujara.
Straying down the leg side and Kohli just eases it through mid-wicket. The ball slows down before the rope and Harris picks it up after chasing. Three taken.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it out to mid off.

Risky single! A length ball around off, Pujara dabs it down towards backward point and attempts for a quick single. Kohli responds and puts his head down as he sprints to the other end. Khawaja has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Starts with a very full delivery on off, Pujara defends it off his front foot.
Pat Cummins is back on.
Tossed up ball on off, Kohli leans forward and blocks it safely.
Quicker, flatter and shorter outside off, Virat goes back and defends it down.
The line is too straight and it spins down the leg side, Kohli works it off his pads but finds backward square leg.
Floated off spinner on off, Virat defends it by prodding forward.
Uses his feet again and flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Jumps out of the crease and brings his bat and pad together in defense. Gets hit on the front pad as his bat was hiding behind.
Drops it on a length and just outside off, Kohli remains inside the crease and defends it watchfully to the off side.
Hurls in a good length delivery outside off, holding its line, Kohli shoulders arms.
Angling into the batsman from outside off, Virat sticks back and blocks.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Gets behind the line to defend but it takes the outer half of his bat and rolls towards the off side.
Beauty! Hazlewood lands it on a good length outside off, Pujara pushes inside the line but it straightens to beat the outside edge.
On middle, Kohli works it off his front foot to mid-wicket.
Extra spin and bounce, probably hitting the footmarks, Kohli is forward in defense but misses. Is hit on the pads but no real appealing. Too high.
Quicker one, flicked with the spin to mid-wicket.

OUCH! That must have hurt. Finch ain't showing much though. A firm flick shot by Kohli in front of short leg and it bounces to hit Finch on the neck. That looks painful but after catching his breath back, Aaron is ready to field.
Catch is the shout... A flat delivery, spinning into the batsman sharply, Kohli tries to work it away but seems to have missed it. The ball loops in the air but drops safely near short leg.
Off spinner, on the shorter side, Pujara uses the depth of his crease and flicks it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! A juicy half-volley on middle and leg, Kohli leans forward and across before flicking it beautifully through mid-wicket for a glorious boundary.
Angling back into the batsman from a length outside off, Kohli leans forward a touch and plays it down to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, it's left alone.
Kohli has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish and on off, defended off the back foot.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Spinning back in, Pujara tries to defend and keeps it out off the inside edge.
Shout for an lbw! Once again turn and bounce for Lyon. Pujara steps down the track and then leaves it to get hit on the pads. Too much spin.
Walks down the track and pushes it out to mid on.
Moves back to a short delivery and turns it towards square leg for one. 1000 Test runs for Virat Kohli in Australia, becomes only the 4th Indian to achieve this feat.

That's perfect Nathan Lyon. Loopy delivery, full and outside off and turning back in with some extra lift. Kohli prods forward to play the cover fielder but is beaten on the inside edge. That wasn't too far away from the off pole.
Floated off spinner on off, Kohli leans forward and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Targets the off pole with a length delivery, Pujara is solidly behind the line in defense.
Gentle delivery, on a good length outside off, holding its line, Che allows it through to the keeper.
A touch short and around off, angling in, Pujara brings down a straight bat and defends it from the inner half.
A bit edgy. On a length around off, Kohli stays back to defend but it takes the outer half of his bat and rolls through the gap at point for one.
Angling into the batsman, Kohli shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Beaten! Lovely delivery. Every time he comes on to bowl, he asks tough questions to the batsmen. Accuracy is his main quality. Just puts a length ball around off and gets it to straighten off the seam. Kohli tries to defend but gets beaten.
Flatter and on off, the batter blocks it out.
Pujara this time works it towards square leg, there is a fielder there so a dot.
Goes back and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Worked with the turn to the man at mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, the batter blocks it.
This is flatter around off, Pujara guides it through point for a run.
We're back for the last session. 32 overs left in the day's play. The players are back on the field. Nathan Lyon to continue from this end. Here we go...
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

Australia, however, then fought back by removing both the openers in quick succession. Their bowling though has been a touch inconsistent. Hazlewood and Lyon have impressed in this session but they need their other bowlers to step up as well. Wickets are what they need after the break and they would want to get rid of the two batting out there as soon as possible. For India, one big partnership is all they require to swell their lead to an extent that will start to bother the Aussies. What is in store after the break? Will India continue to have their noses in front or will Australia finish the day on a high? Stay tuned to find out.

A good session of Test cricket but it will be India who will walk off as the happier side. They have stretched their lead to a run above 100 and have only lost two wickets. Their openers gave them a solid start. Both Vijay and Rahul began cautiously but then started getting into their own. The latter especially, he started scoring freely and the duo added 63 for the first wicket.
So that too has been negotiated well! Short and on the body, it is worked around the corner through square leg for a run. That will be TEA ON DAY 3!
Goes wide of the crease again but bowls it outside off, left alone. One ball to negotiate before Tea.

Lovely stuff! Goes wide of the crease and angles it in the direction of the off pole. It pitches and then moves away. Also, takes off after kissing the deck. Pujara does well to play it right in front of his eyes and with soft hands.
Outside off, Pujara does not fiddle with it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length ball on off, Pujara defends it onto the ground.
Prefers playing Lyon on the back foot as he does that there. Works it to square leg with the turn.
Well bowled! Spin and bounce there! This is tossed up on off, it pitches and turns back in. Kohli tries to keep it out but the ball goes off the gloves towards the on side.
Flatter but a touch shorter. Kohli goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Once again uses his feet and then flicks it towards square leg for a quick run. The lead is now 100.
Uses his feet and then works it to mid-wicket.
Goes back and works this around the corner to take the lead to 99.
Too wide outside off, Pujara leaves it again.
On the shorter side this time, Pujara defends it onto the ground.
Gets this to tail back in from outside off, Pujara lunges and blocks it out.
A little too wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
On the 5th stump channel, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Good batting! Waits for the ball, lets it do its bit and then guides it towards backward point for a run.
A little too full and Kohli strokes it down to long on for a run.
Kohli tries to works it on the leg side with the turn but the fielder at short leg comes in the way.
Good lines and lengths. Pitches it around off, Kohli lunges forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up on off, the ball pitches and comes back in. Pujara tries to defend but the ball goes off the pads and over the leg slip fielder. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Uses his feet and then strokes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length and outside off, Kohli shoulders arms.
BEATEN! Good length and around off, Kohli plays inside the line and gets beaten. This is the wicket Australia would want and that too quickly.
On a length and around off, Kohli is solid in defense.
FOUR LEG BYES! A poor delivery to bowl first up! On the pads, Kohli though misses the flick, the ball brushes the pads and races to the fine leg fence.
Virat Kohli is the next man in. He's welcomed with boos from a section of crowd. Hmm...

OUT! There goes another one! Rahul throws away the start and Australia slowly creeping back into the game. This is on a length and around off, Rahul goes for the lofted cover drive. The ball though was not full enough. It takes the outside edge and settles into the mitts of Paine. Waste of a wicket really, there was a chance of scoring a half century for him. He just finds ways to get out.
Good length around off, Rahul defends it.
Advances down the track and pads it out to end an eventful over.

NOT OUT! Nothing on the Hot Spot. Nothing on the Snicko. The decision is overruled. A flatter off spinner outside off, turning back in just a hint. Pujara stays back to play inside the line but seems to have missed it. Paine though collects the ball, puts in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Pujara looks down for a moment and then goes for the DRS. The replays roll in and Che survives. Good use of the technology. That was a great delivery, to be honest. The length was such that Pujara was in two minds with his footwork.
Shout for a caught behind! The finger has gone up. Pujara almost immediately reviews it.
Long hop outside off, Rahul plays it late and places it past point for a run.
Lunges and brings his bat close to front pad in defense.
Flat delivery, turning back in sharply from outside off. Rahul leans forward to defend but it probably takes his gloves and falls wide of short leg and leg gully.
Turn and bounce outside off, KL pads it away.
A back foot defense to complete the over. A maiden.
Nice wicket to wicket line by Hazlewood. Offering nothing to the batsman. Pujara too is not bothered. Stays back inside the crease and blocks it.
This time the line is a little too straight, Pujara brings his wrists into use and flicks it off his pads. Fails to beat the backward square leg fielder though.
Keeps probing with a length delivery and lands it around off, Pujara is solid in his front foot defense.
Serves this one just ahead of a length around off, Pujara gets half forward and pushes it gently with an angled bat towards gully.
Extra bounce. A length ball around off, angling in, Pujara fails to flick and takes a beating high on his left leg.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Tossed up ball on middle, turning back in, Pujara moves back and eases it through square leg. Harris chases it down with a slide and they cross.
Jumps out of the crease but after seeing the line to be outside off, he pads it away.
Works it away with the spin on the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Slower one, landing a bit short outside off and turning in, Pujara tries defending but is hit on the front pad. Impact outside off, that's why only a stifled appeal for an lbw.
Full and floated on middle, Pujara uses his feet and flicks it across the line. Finds mid-wicket.
Lets the ball to spin back in from outside off and then punches it through point for a single.
Provides width outside off and invites the batsman to go after it. Pujara is not too eager to chase everything. Allows it through.
Switches to 'round the wicket and hurls across a good length delivery outside off, Pujara covers the line and leaves it alone.
A back foot defense to a 145.7 kph shortish delivery.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, Che has nothing to do with it.

FOUR! Don't bowl there to him. He might come across as a defensive batsman but that's too short and wide to demand any respect. Plenty of width there and Pujara cracks it off his back foot through point.
Bowls a fuller length delivery on middle, Pujara gets forward and defends it back.
Uses his feet and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Again the reverse sweep, connects well this time through short third man. Three taken.
Flighted ball outside off, Rahul defends it.
Fires it on middle, Rahul thinks of flicking it but seeing the bounce bails out of the shot. It hits his thigh pad and goes towards leg slip.
In the air... but in the gap! Pujara comes down the track and tries to flick. The ball though holds up a little, goes off the higher portion and uppishly towards wide mid on for a run.
Flatter and on off, Pujara defends it off the back foot.
Off the mark with a clip to fine leg. He retains strike.
A bumper this time and it is on the body. Pujara ducks under it.
A little too wide outside off, CP won't be playing at those.
Right on the money to him! On middle and it is on a length. Pujara defends it.
Cheteshwar Pujara, the hero of the first innings, is the next man in.

OUT! Starc strikes! Australia draw first blood. A much-needed wicket as this partnership was really starting to flourish. A similar way to how Vijay got out to Starc in the first innings. It is full and outside off, the sucker ball. Vijay is sucked into the drive, he plays it away from his body. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards second slip where Handscomb takes a nice catch by diving to his left. India are effectively 78 for 1.
Slightly short and outside off, the batsman cuts it through point for a run.
Down the leg side, it is left alone.
Loopy ball outside off, Rahul pushes it through covers for a single.
Flatter and around off, Rahul defends it out. He then picks the ball up and throws it back to the bowler.
Nicely tossed up around off, Vijay is forward to defend. The ball though goes off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
Brings out the reverse sweep, does not get it off the middle but hits it well enough to get three as the ball goes towards the third man region.
Good delivery! The straighter one outside off, Rahul hangs his bat out but gets beaten.
Slips another delivery down the leg side, Rahul turns it off his pads to deep backward square leg for a run. A much-better over by Starc.
Back of a length delivery on leg, Rahul defends it from the crease to mid-wicket.

Nearly kissed the gloves. Starc digs in a short ball and directs it at the body of the batsman. Rahul is in no position as he initially shapes up to duck. But then he tries to pull at the last moment. Misses the ball. Paine collects and knows that it wasn't too far away from the gloves.
Shortish on middle and off, KL jumps and blocks it safely.
Fullish and on off, Rahul gets forward and across as he tries to defend. Keeps the ball out off the inner half of his blade.
Starts with a length ball around off, angling away from the batsman, Rahul gets a bit forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Mitchell Starc returns in the attack.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
This is bowled shorter in length on middle, Vijay flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

Close! This is flatter and on middle, extra bounce on this one. Rahul tries to flick but it goes off the gloves towards leg slip. Finch there stretches his left hand out but can't hold on to the catch. That needed to stick. A tough chance but it will still go down as a DROPPED CATCH.

An appeal but not given! Tossed up outside off, it turns back in. Rahul tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Paine and Lyon have a chat in the middle but then do not review and rightly so as the impact was outside off.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. They pick up a single.
Floats it up outside off, Rahul tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards square leg for a single.
Drinks!
Outside off, left alone. A dot to end but an excellent over for India. 11 from it.
Another bouncer, Rahul this time though plays the pull towards fine leg. A run is taken.
A perfect fast bowler's response. Hit for a boundary in the last ball now bangs it short and on the body. Rahul ducks under it.

FOUR! Beautiful, just beautiful. Full and in the zone for Rahul. He strokes it through covers and the ball races away to the fence. He looks delightful when he plays through the off side. Also the fifty is up for India, first 50-partnership between the two away from home. Ideal start provided by the openers.
What a comeback that is! Bends his back on this one and lands it around off, the ball takes off after pitching. Rahul tries to push it through the off side but gets beaten by the extra bounce.
SIX! How good was that? Wow! Take that, says Rahul to Cummins. Full and outside off, Lokesh deliberately plays the lofted square drive. The timing is such that it carries over the point fence.
Once again brings out the paddle, this time connects and collects a double as the ball goes towards fine leg.

Sharp turn again! This is floated outside off, Vijay plants his front foot outside off and tries to defend but the ball turns back in and hits the front pad. A huge appeal follows but it is not given. However, these are encouraging sings for Lyon as he is getting good turn.
Brings out the paddle but misses due to the big turn. The keeper too fails to collect it as there was extra bounce also. It goes towards the fine leg region for two byes.
Tosses it up outside off, aiming for the rough. Vijay lunges and defends it.
This is flatter and on middle, Vijay goes back and works it to square leg.

And straightaway he creates something. He lands it outside off, it spins back in sharply. Vijay tries to defend but the ball lobs off his pads towards short leg. The crowd gets excited but the players don't.
Nathan Lyon is into the attack.
Around off and on a length, Rahul gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it.
A rib-tickler there by Cummins. Vijay manages to work it through square leg for a single.
On a length and around off, it is kept out.
Good length again on off, Vijay blocks it out.
Uppish but well short! On a length and around off, Vijay goes at it with hard hands. The ball hits the higher portion of the bat and it is uppish for a while but lands well short of mid off.
Goes very full and on middle, Vijay somehow jams it out.
Nathan Lyon is seen warming up.
If Rahul can do it so can Vijay. He, this time, leans into the shot and then times it through covers for another three. 24 from the last 3 overs. The lead is now 50.
This is a top shot! Does not go to the boundary but it is very pleasing to the eye. Full and around off, leans into the drive and then strokes it through covers for three.
Length and around off, the batsman makes a leave.

Rahul seems to have lost his shape on that shot but still gets runs off it. This is fuller and on off, Rahul goes for another expansive drive with no foot movement. It goes off the inner half through mid-wicket and a couple is taken.
A stifled appeal but it is going down leg. Pitched around middle and off, jags back in. Rahul tries to flick but is hit just above the pads.
Runs starting to come now! Just a single this time though. It is flicked to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Streaky! They say if you go for the cut, you should go hard and that is exactly what Rahul does here. Slashes at the ball which is short and outside off, he gets an outside edge over the slip cordon and into the third man fence.
Expansive! Rahul tries to go over covers, a shot we have seen him play in colored clothing. Luckily it whizzes past the outside edge. That shot was never on.
Works it with the angle and through square leg for a couple. India are effectively 37 for 0.
A short ball and Rahul evades it. The bouncer is a good ploy but the wicket is a touch slow to make the batsman worry about it.
Slightly fuller in length around off, Vijay tries to stroke it through the cover region without moving his feet. He gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Hits the length hard on off, Vijay gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it.
A bumper to end the over, Rahul ducks under it.
FOUR! Authoritative shot! Nothing much wrong with the delivery, it is slightly full and on off, Rahul plays the lofted cover drive and it races to the fence. First boundary off the bat.
Once again it is played with soft hands! Back of a length around off, Vijay plays it with an open-face of the bat towards third man for three. Seen a lot triples today.
A good short ball and it is equally well played. Vijay defends it by taking a hand off the handle.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Nicely played! This comes back in after pitching on middle, Rahul plays it late through square leg for a run.
Fullish and wide outside off, left alone to complete the over.

Aahhh...spoke a little too soon! Rahul goes after a length delivery outside off, almost like running out of patience. He drives it in the air but luckily for him it goes safely through the gap at covers. Travis Head chases it and pulls it back with a slide just before the rope. Three taken.

Angles in a full length ball, attacking the stumps, Rahul leans forward and defends it with a straight bat. The approach so far from both the openers shows that they have learnt from their mistakes in the first innings.
Good leave. This has been served in the region outside off, Rahul covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
A little short on this occasion, Rahul nicely gets behind the line, stays back-footed and then blocks.
Starts his spell with a length delivery in the line of the stumps, Rahul covers the line and pushes it towards mid on.
Pat Cummins replaces Mitchell Starc in the attack.
Very full outside off, Vijay jams it out. Another good over by Hazlewood.
Now bowls a tempter. Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Goes for the big booming inswinger. The line though is a little too straight. Vijay tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire turns it down. Going down leg.
Goes fuller in length around off, Vijay strokes it towards mid off.
Good bumper, the batsman ducks under it. This is very good by Josh, getting some to swing away, bringing some in. He is also using the bouncers. Top stuff, good battle between him and Vijay.
Right on the money! On a length and around off, Vijay goes back and defends it towards covers.
Short and outside off, left alone. Starc has not got it right in this spell. This may just have been his last over in this spell.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor delivery! Down the leg side, Rahul misses the flick and it brushes the pads before going fine to the fence.
Good bowling! Bends his back on this one and bowls it on a back of a length outside off, Rahul does well to leave it alone.
Goes for a yorker but gets it wrong. Ends up bowling a knee height full toss. Rahul is caught by surprise, he tries to defend but gets an outside edge to point.
Once again it is bowled outside off, Rahul does not fiddle with it.
A little too wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
BEATEN! End of a very testing over. Just ahead of a length around off, the ball pitches and holds its line. Vijay goes for the drive but gets beaten.
On the stumps and it is blocked.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

A muted appeal but the umpire is not interested! On a length and around off, this one jags back in. Vijay tries to defend but seems to have gotten an inside edge onto the pads. Replays show that it was the bat hitting the pad and the ball hit Vijay high on the pads.
Perfect line! Right on off, the only thing missing there was the swing. Vijay defends it.
Good shape there! Full and outside off, it swings away. The batsman shoulders arms to it. Needs to start a little more closer to the off pole.
Outside off, left alone. A maiden by Starc, not a threatening one though.
Goes a touch short this time, Rahul defends it. Starc in his followthrough has a look behind. Maybe a glimpse at the landing area.
Another good delivery! On a length and around middle, Rahul defends it back towards the bowler.
Gets it right this time. Bowls a yorker around middle and leg. Rahul jams it out.
This is way outside off, Rahul shoulders arms.
Wayward delivery to begin with! Down the leg side, Rahul misses the flick and Tim behind the stumps dives to his left and collects it.
Just ahead of a length around off, Vijay defends it onto the ground.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on off, Vijay gets right behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out.
Good change in length there! The surprise bouncer, Vijay was surprised by it, he though manages to evade it at the last moment.

Outside off, left alone. So this is a more watchful innings by the Indian openers so far. They were quite eager to go after the deliveries outside off in the first innings. This time though, they are opting to leave it.
Angles it into the batsman, Vijay defends it out.
Full around off, Vijay strokes it to mid on.
A single to end the over! This is worked with the swing through the square leg region.
Goes short this time but it is outside off, Vijay watches it go through to the keeper.
This is closer to the off pole but not close enough to make the batsman play.
Once again it is bowled outside off, Starc is trying to get the ball to curl back in. It though goes on with the angle and Vijay makes a leave.
Nicely timed! Fuller and on off, Vijay strokes it beautifully through covers and collects a brace. He gets off the mark.
Wide outside off, left alone. 6th leave in a row.
A little too wide outside off, Rahul makes another leave. A maiden.
This one comes back in and Hazlewood also gets some good carry. Good length outside off, it jags in, not enough though to make the batsman play.
Well left again! Once again it is angled in first and then moves away. Rahul covers his off stump and lets it be.
Well bowled! This is first angled into the off pole and then starts moving away. Rahul spots that and at the very end decides to leave it.
A little fuller than the last delivery but the line is outside off, it is left alone.
Back of a length to begin with. Rahul goes back and defends it to point.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
Once again it was the in-dipper on middle, Vijay is half-forward as he plays it to mid-wicket.
This time Vijay had his eyes on the ball and he is rock solid in defense. It was on a length and it came back in a little.
A snorter there! Short and right on the body of the batsman. Vijay takes his eyes off the ball as he tries to defend. Luckily for Vijay it dies onto the ground after hitting his glove.
India open their account as Rahul flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and around off, looking for some swing, there ain't any and Rahul strokes it back to the bowler.
A gentle delivery to begin with by Starc. On a length and outside off, it is left alone. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
